layers.name: Ocean observations (Ocean Data Initiative)
layers.description: Tide gauges, weather buoys and Argo float profiles, each checked against independent sources by the QEM.
attribution: NOAA CO-OPS (Tides and Currents): US Government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).
Marine Institute Ireland (Irish Weather Buoy Network): CC BY 4.0, crediting the Marine Institute.
Argo floats (via Ifremer ERDDAP): Argo data are free and unrestricted; cite Argo (doi:10.17882/42182).
Open-Meteo Marine Weather API: CC BY 4.0, crediting Open-Meteo.com. The free API is for non-commercial use; commercial use needs an API plan.
NASA/JPL MUR SST v4.1 (via NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP): NASA open data, free to use with attribution (JPL MUR MEaSUREs Project, doi:10.5067/GHGMR-4FJ04).
OBIS (Ocean Biodiversity Information System): Per dataset: CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC, carried on each speck.

layers.name: Coral reef heat stress
layers.description: NOAA Coral Reef Watch's bleaching alert and Degree Heating Weeks at Atlantic Rim reef sites.
attribution: NOAA Coral Reef Watch 5 km (via PacIOOS ERDDAP): NOAA near-real-time product, public domain. The dataset also carries a Met Office OSTIA academic-only statement, which covers only its 1985-2002 reanalysis; the QEM fetches current days only.

layers.name: EEZs: protection and ocean finance
layers.description: The EEZs of the Initiative's places and reefs, with their country's marine protected area coverage and active World Bank ocean projects.
attribution: Marine Regions EEZ boundaries (VLIZ): CC BY 4.0, crediting Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ), Marine Regions.
World Bank World Development Indicators: CC BY 4.0, crediting the World Bank.
UN Global SDG Indicators Database: UN data, free to use with attribution to the UN Statistics Division, Global SDG Indicators Database.
World Bank Projects & Operations: CC BY 4.0, crediting the World Bank.

IATI Datastore (International Aid Transparency Initiative): Open data published by each reporting organisation under its own licence (most CC BY or ODbL); accessed through the IATI Datastore API under IATI's terms of use.

layers.name: Sargassum (floating algae index)
layers.description: NOAA AOML's Alternative Floating Algae Index, a 7-day satellite composite, in a box around each place: clear cells, how many are at the product's 0.004 cap, and the mean and highest index. What one satellite product saw, not tonnes on a beach; not for legal use.
attribution: NOAA AOML sargassum (AFAI, 7-day): NOAA AOML OceanWatch: may be used and redistributed for free but is not intended for legal use.

layers.name: Marine microplastics samples
layers.description: Microplastics samples from published studies across the Atlantic, gathered by NOAA NCEI: where and when each was taken, the medium, method and mesh, the concentration and its unit, and the study with its DOI. Two samples from one study are one voice.
attribution: NOAA NCEI Marine Microplastics: US Government work (NOAA NCEI compilation), public domain; each study under its own terms.
